criteria.evidence: Recommends a read-only role instead of admin, grants only SELECT on specific schema/tables, suggests column/table restriction, uses admin only once to create the role.
Explicitly advises against giving the agent admin access, explaining the risks of DROP/UPDATE/GRANT, and presents admin use only as a fallback with mitigations.
Restricts the tool via read-only role, default_transaction_read_only, read-only connection, row limit, statement timeout, specific tables/views, and keeps credentials out of the agent's context.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
